==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/fɒnt/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/fɑnt/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-font.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Etymology 1===
{{wp|holy water +}}
[[File:Colonna - la Maddalena acquasantiera 1050336.JPG|thumb|upright|A holy water '''font''']]

{{etymid|en|fountain-related}}
From {{inh|en|ang|font}}, an early borrowing from {{der|en|la|fons|fōns, fontis|fountain}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{sid|en|receptacle for holy water}} {{lb|en|Christianity}} A [[receptacle]] in a church for [[holy water]], especially one used in [[baptism]].
#: {{syn|en|stoup<id:receptacle for holy water>}}
#: {{hypo|en|baptismal font}}
#: {{ux|en|She dipped her fingers in the '''font''' and [[cross oneself|crossed herself]].}}
#* {{quote-book|en|title=Catholic Encyclopedia|volume=2|chapter=[[s:en:Catholic Encyclopedia (1913)/Baptismal Font|Baptismal Font]]|author=w:John Bertram Peterson|year=1913|passage=In the Apostolic Age, as in Jewish times (John, iii, 23), baptism was administered without special '''fonts''', at the seaside or in streams or pools of water (Acts, viii, 38); {{...}}}}
# {{sid|en|receptacle for lamp oil}} A [[receptacle]] for [[lamp oil]] in a [[lamp]].

===Etymology 2===
{{wp|+ (typography)}}
{{etymid|en|melting-and-foundry-related}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*ǵʰewd-}}
From {{der|en|frm|fonte|t=act or process of founding or melting; act of producing items from molten metal; cast iron; set of type}} (modern {{cog|fr|fonte}}), either:<ref>{{R:OED Online|pos=''n.''{{sup|2}}|noformat=1|id=8509752908|date=December 2024|nodot=1}}; {{R:Lexico|alt=font{{sup|2}}|pos=n|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220812233516/https://www.lexico.com/definition/font}}</ref>

* from {{m|frm|fondre|t=to melt, melt down; to smelt}}, from {{der|en|fro|fondre}}, from {{der|en|la|fundere}}, the {{glossary|present}} {{glossary|active}} {{glossary|infinitive}} of {{m|la|fundō|t=to pour out; to make by smelting, found}}, ultimately from {{der|en|ine-pro|*ǵʰewd-|t=to pour}}; or
* from {{der|en|la-lat|*fundita}}, a {{glossary|noun}} use of {{m|la-lat|funditus}}, a {{glossary|perfect}} {{glossary|passive}} {{glossary|participle}} form of {{der|en|la|fundō}} (see above; the classical Latin form is {{m|la|fūsus}}).

====Alternative forms====
* {{alter|en|fount||archaic}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{sid|en|subset of a typeface or its forms}} {{lb|en|typography}} A set of [[glyph]]s of unified design, belonging to one [[typeface]] (e.g., Helvetica), [[style]] (e.g., [[italic]]), and [[weight]] (e.g., [[bold]]). Usually representing the [[letter]]s of an [[alphabet]] and its supplementary [[character]]s.
## In metal [[typesetting]], a set of type [[sort]]s in one size.
## In [[phototypesetting]], a set of [[pattern]]s forming glyphs of any size, or the [[film]] they are stored on.
## In [[digital]] typesetting, a set of glyphs in a single style, representing one or more alphabets or [[writing system]]s, or the computer code representing it.
# {{sid|en|typeface, broadly}} {{lb|en|originally|computing|typography|informal}} A [[typeface]].
# {{sid|en|computer file encoding a typeface or subset thereof}} {{lb|en|computing|typography|metonymically}} A computer [[file]] containing the [[code]] used to draw and compose the glyphs of one or more typographic fonts on a computer [[display]] or [[printer]].
#: {{ux|en|They bought a license for the Gulliver '''font''' and installed that '''font''' on several machines.}}
# {{lb|en|informal}}{{attn|en|has anyone proscribed this yet?}} The design of any text.
#: {{syn|en|lettering}}
#: {{ux|en|I like the '''font''' of this logo.}}

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|television|informal}} To [[overlay]] (text) on the [[picture]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1987|author=The Foundation Center|title=Promoting issues & ideas: a guide to public relations for nonprofit organizations|page=97|passage={{...}} character generator instead of an easel card to create letters on camera or telephone numbers that can run across the TV screen. The process is called '''fonting'''.}}

===Etymology 3===
Apparently from {{m|en|fount}}, with influence from the senses above (under etymology 1).

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|figuratively}} A [[source]], [[wellspring]], [[fount]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1910|author=w:Arthur Edward Waite|title=s:The Pictorial Key to the Tarot|section=part II
|passage=As I am not drawing here on the '''font''' of imagination to refresh that of fact and experience, I do not suggest that the Tarot set the example of expressing Secret Doctrine in pictures and that it was followed by Hermetic writers; but it is noticeable that it is perhaps the earliest example of this art.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1915|author=w:Woodrow Wilson|title=[[s:Woodrow Wilson's Third State of the Union Address|Third State of the Union Address]]
|passage=I am interested to fix your attention on this prospect now because unless you take it within your view and permit the full significance of it to command your thought I cannot find the right light in which to set forth the particular matter that lies at the very '''font''' of my whole thought as I address you to-day.}}
